Mind, body, and environment influence one another. Repeated practice can teach your nervous system new responses through learning and neuroplasticity. This does not mean that a single thought controls your genes, guarantees healing, or makes you responsible for feeling this way.

string-array.item: There is immediate danger, or you feel you might harm yourself or someone else.
You have intense or new chest pain or pressure, have fainted, or are struggling to breathe.
You notice sudden weakness, severe confusion, difficulty speaking, or a new neurological symptom.
You have taken an overdose or a dangerous substance, or suffered a serious injury.
You cannot keep yourself safe or are unsure whether this is only an emotional response.
